blocks.content: Counting sort is a way to arrange the items in a vector by counting how many times each item appears. We then put the elements in order based on those counts.

items: Create a counting vector whose size is one more than the largest element in the unsorted vector.
Fill each index of the counting vector with the number of occurrences of the corresponding value in the unsorted vector.
Create a sorted vector using the value of each index in the counting vector.
